exposure: IBD medication during pregnancy and breastfeeding
outcome: Safety of IBD medication during pregnancy and breastfeeding
cohort: Pregnant women with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD).
finding: Position statements were developed emphasizing the importance of joined-up multidisciplinary care, proactive decision-making, clear documentation, and effective communication for pregnant women with IBD.
mod_finding: All pregnant women with IBD should be advised on the optimal mode of delivery.
